features.sectionSubtitle: Thoughtfully designed features that help you find meaningful connections safely.

discovery.title: Smart Discovery & Matching
discovery.description: Card-based discovery with Like, Super Like, and Pass. Your feed is personalized based on your preferences. Mutual likes create matches.
discovery.benefit: Find compatible people without endless scrolling.

profiles.title: Detailed Profiles
profiles.description: Photos, bio, interests, and attributes including gender, age, height, residency, ethnicity, nationality, religion, education, occupation, relationship intention, and more. Photos are moderated before appearing.
profiles.benefit: Make informed decisions based on values and culture.

preferences.title: Preferences & Filters
preferences.description: Filter by interested-in, age range, max distance, preferred residency (Ethiopia, Eritrea, Diaspora), verified-only, and discovery mode (Standard, Global, Incognito).
preferences.benefit: See only the profiles that matter to you.

location.title: Location-Based Discovery
location.description: GPS proximity with manual city search fallback. Regional filters: Nearby, Ethiopia, Eritrea, Diaspora, Anywhere.
location.benefit: Find people near you or across the diaspora.

chat.title: Real-Time Chat
chat.description: Text messaging, image sharing (up to 5 per message, 25 MB max), and voice messages with recording, preview, and playback.

matches.title: Matches & Likes
matches.description: A dedicated matches screen keeps all your connections organized. A likes screen shows who liked you (premium feature).
matches.benefit: Never lose track of your connections.

verification.title: Profile Verification
verification.description: Earn a verified badge and filter for verified-only profiles.
verification.benefit: Confidence you're talking to a real person.

photoModeration.title: Photo Moderation
photoModeration.description: Automated and manual review process. Photo status is shown as pending, approved, or under review.

blockReport.title: Block & Report
blockReport.description: Blocking hides all contact with a person. Reports go directly to our moderation team.
blockReport.benefit: Control your safety at every step.

incognito.title: Incognito Mode (Premium)
incognito.description: Browse without appearing in others' discovery feeds.
incognito.benefit: Privacy and discretion when you want it.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.description: TLS encryption, secure token storage, and Supabase row-level security protect your data.

accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion
accountDeletion.description: Permanently delete your account from Settings. All your data is removed — no lock-in.
accountDeletion.benefit: Full control over your presence on Qaliye.

about.title: About Qaliye
about.subtitle: Building the bridge between culture and connection.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Qaliye exists to help Ethiopian and Eritrean singles find meaningful connections — whether at home or across the diaspora. We believe dating should be rooted in shared culture, values, and respect, not endless swiping. Our platform is designed to foster genuine relationships while honoring the traditions and heritage that make our community unique.

audience.title: Who We Serve
audience.body: Qaliye is built for Ethiopian and Eritrean singles aged 18 and above, both within the Horn of Africa and across the global diaspora. Whether you're in Addis Ababa, Asmara, Washington DC, or London, Qaliye helps you find someone who understands your world.

value.title: What Makes Us Different
value.body: We're not just another dating app. Qaliye is built specifically for the Ethiopian and Eritrean community — with support for four languages, culturally relevant filters, local payment options, and a commitment to safety through verification and moderation. We prioritize meaningful connections over casual encounters.

trust.title: Trust & Safety
trust.description: Verification, photo moderation, and robust reporting tools keep our community safe.

culture.title: Cultural Alignment
culture.description: We celebrate Ethiopian and Eritrean heritage in every aspect of the app.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: Your data is encrypted and never sold to third parties. You control your presence.

respect.title: Respect
respect.description: We foster an inclusive, respectful community — never objectifying or pressuring.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions and get the support you need.
help.contactSupport: Still need help? Contact our support team.

1.question: How do I create a Qaliye account?
1.answer: Download the app from the App Store or Google Play, then follow the in-app setup to create your profile with photos, bio, and preferences.

2.question: Is Qaliye free to use?
2.answer: Yes, Qaliye is free to download and use with core features. Premium features like See Who Liked You, Boost, and unlimited likes are available as upgrades.

3.question: How does profile verification work?
3.answer: You can request verification within the app. Once approved, you'll receive a verified badge. You can also filter your discovery to show verified profiles only.

4.question: How do I delete my account?
4.answer: Go to Settings in the app and select Account Deletion. This permanently removes your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

5.question: Which languages does Qaliye support?
5.answer: Qaliye supports English, Amharic, Tigrinya, and Afaan Oromo. You can switch languages anytime in the app settings.

6.question: How does photo moderation work?
6.answer: All photos go through automated and manual review before appearing on your profile. You'll see the status of each photo as pending, approved, or under review.

7.question: What payment methods are available?
7.answer: On Android, you can pay with Telebirr, bank transfer, Chapa, or manual receipt. On iOS, payments are processed through the App Store.

8.question: Can I use Qaliye outside Ethiopia or Eritrea?
8.answer: Yes! Qaliye is available worldwide. You can filter discovery by Nearby, Ethiopia, Eritrea, Diaspora, or Anywhere to find connections wherever you are.

accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion
accountDeletion.subtitle: Learn how to permanently delete your Qaliye account and associated data.
accountDeletion.introTitle: Your Right to Delete Your Account
accountDeletion.introBody: You have the right to delete your Qaliye account at any time. When you delete your account, your profile, photos, messages, matches, and associated personal data will be permanently removed from our systems.
accountDeletion.inAppDescription: You can delete your account directly within the Qaliye app — no need to contact support.
accountDeletion.emailDescription: To request the deletion of your account and associated data, please email support@qaliye.com with the subject line 'Account Deletion Request' from the email address registered to your account.

process.step1: Your request will be reviewed and processed within 30 days.
process.step2: Your profile, photographs, bio, preferences, and matches will be permanently removed.
process.step3: Your messages and chat history with other users will be deleted.
process.step4: Some data may be retained where required by law for legal, tax, or safety purposes.

accountDeletion.note: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. If you change your mind, you will need to create a new account.
accountDeletion.dataManagementBody: You do not need to delete your entire account to remove specific content. The Qaliye app allows you to delete individual items at any time:

dataManagement.photos: Delete photos directly from your Profile screen.
dataManagement.messages: Delete individual chat messages from within the Chat screen.
